biological_meaning: minimum legitimate visit rate per minute worth being able to detect
production_rule: freeze a biologically relevant visit/min value before screen outcomes; do not substitute pollination-rate percentages or a non-significant treatment effect
notes: 2015 directly observed bumblebee visitation; searchable text confirms visitation analyses but not a production-ready baseline rate

biological_meaning: probability of at least one pollinator detection when true rate equals the frozen minimum relevant rate
production_rule: freeze prospectively; higher requested probability can only increase observation effort

biological_meaning: minimum number and duration of observation bouts needed to avoid one short time window defining context
production_rule: freeze bout count/minutes before screen outcomes and record coverage rationale
notes: separate from the Poisson total-minute requirement

biological_meaning: minimum attacked-flower prevalence worth being able to detect
production_rule: freeze a biological relevance/transport value before screen outcomes; historical predation percentages cannot be copied automatically
notes: 2013 and 2016 show strong year/density/population dependence in predispersal predation

biological_meaning: probability of at least one attacked flower when true prevalence equals the frozen minimum relevant prevalence
production_rule: freeze prospectively; planner converts it to flower count
notes: zero after completed effort remains context-uninformative

biological_meaning: minimum fraction of flowering plants expected to carry a functional measurable water state during the screen window
production_rule: prefer fresh independent natural-history calibration or a tightly transported external bound
notes: water state is rainfall-dependent, so historical functional reality does not determine current prevalence

biological_meaning: probability of at least one water-positive plant at the frozen minimum relevant prevalence
production_rule: freeze prospectively; planner converts it to plant count
notes: zero after completed effort remains context-uninformative

biological_meaning: reserve above the disjoint Y-CAL 36 + D0-CAL 48 base plant floor
production_rule: freeze reserve fraction before site census; census stops at required capacity or must exhaust focal population
notes: capacity shortfall cannot be declared from a partial census
